summary: Sony vehicular-combat series; pick modern PS4/PS5 classic releases when they preserve the original content with official up-rendering, and use original hardware/emulation for entries without a modern route.

entries.title: Twisted Metal

emulation.notes: DuckStation is useful for original-disc comparison.

primary.why: The modern PlayStation release preserves the original PlayStation game while adding official up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and video filters.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use DuckStation only for original-disc archival comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern release is an enhanced classic, not a remake.

entries.title: Twisted Metal 2
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation Classics release plus optional Windows multiplayer sampling

emulation.notes: DuckStation can upscale the original disc if the store release is unavailable.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 release is the official modern route for the original PlayStation version and adds up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and video filters.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use the Windows version only to sample its historical modem/Internet multiplayer.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modem/Internet multiplayer support on the Windows release.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the PC networking feature only if preserving that historical mode matters.
secondary.why: The Windows version has online/modem multiplayer, but sources also note it is built on an earlier version with minor level details missing.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern release is an enhanced classic, not a remake.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern release is an enhanced classic, not a remake.

entries.title: Twisted Metal: Black

emulation.notes: PCSX2 can upscale the PS2 disc when official PS4 access is unavailable.

primary.why: The official PS4 release presents the PS2 classic with 1080p up-rendering, trophies, Share Play, Remote Play, and activity features.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 PlayStation Store release; use PCSX2 or original PS2 hardware if the store release is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4 release is an enhanced emulated PS2 classic, not a full remaster.

emulation.notes: Upscale original PlayStation output; use original hardware if preferred.

primary.why: Small Brawl is a North America-only PlayStation entry with no modern port documented; DuckStation gives the original release the best practical fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PlayStation release through DuckStation with high internal resolution, or use original hardware.

entries.title: Twisted Metal: Black Online

emulation.notes: Archival use only unless a compatible online preservation route is available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS2 online title with server dependency

primary.why: Black Online is a multiplayer-only PS2 variant of Twisted Metal: Black and was distributed separately before later Greatest Hits inclusion.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as an archival PS2 online release; official servers are documented as shut down, so current play depends on preservation/community routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not included in the modern PS4 Twisted Metal: Black release.

entries.title: Twisted Metal: Head-On
entries.definitive_edition: Twisted Metal Head-On: Extra Twisted Edition

emulation.notes: Run the PS2 edition at high internal resolution; PPSSPP is the PSP comparison route.

primary.why: Extra Twisted Edition is a PS2 port with improved presentation and substantial bonus content, including material from the canceled Black sequel and other extras.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 Extra Twisted Edition through PCSX2 at high internal resolution; use PSP/PPSSPP only for the original handheld online-enabled version.

secondary.what_to_play: Sample the PSP version if preserving the original online-enabled handheld feature set matters.
secondary.why: The PS2 Extra Twisted Edition adds more content but lacks the PSP version's online play feature.

entries.remaster_caveats: Extra Twisted Edition was North America-only and lacks the PSP version's online play.

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware if emulation compatibility is not sufficient.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD output / RPCS3 scaling where compatible

primary.why: The 2012 reboot is a PS3-only release; emulation offers the highest-fidelity preservation route when compatible.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or on original PS3 hardware; online gameplay was discontinued in 2019.
